messages:
mari: Heads-up team — I'm handing off the night oncall at 18:00 PT. Quick pre-oncall checklist, please confirm you either have access or can repro the checks below before then. Linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-prep :clipboard:

mari: Checklist: VPN ok, SSH keys loaded, SSO/MFA working, PagerDuty seat + escalation policy, read-only access to prod logs, can trigger a smoke alert, local devtooling (kubectl/gcloud) auth, runbook pinned. If you can't do any item ping here.

alex: on it. I'll test VPN + ssh now.

alex: VPN connected, can reach internal Grafana. SSH to jumpbox works: `ssh redwood-jump@jump.internal` -> ok. :white_check_mark:

jon: I can't see the new escalation policy in PD, hitting `403` when trying to view team settings. @sara can you verify my PD role?

sara: Checking PD... looks like jon is in the old group. Reinvited him to "eng-oncall" team. You should get an invite email in a few mins. :email:

pagerduty-bot: Jon has been added to the eng-oncall escalation policy (role: Oncall). Invite email sent to jon@example.com.

jon: Got it, accepted invite. I can view policies now. :+1:

mari: infra-bot — can you run the automated pre-oncall smoke (k8s health + inference runtime) and paste results?

infra-bot: Running pre-oncall smoke:
```
check-k8s: ok (all namespaces ready)
check-runtime: ok (avg latency 42ms)
trigger-smoke-alert: simulated alert sent to PD — OK
logs-access: ok (read-only token valid)
```

infra-bot: All checks passed. If anyone wants me to run a deeper trace or run the kv-cache warmup script, say so.

alex: Can you add a quick command here for smoke alert trigger? Folks might need it during handoff.

mari: Sure — run this from jumpbox: 
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.internal/ops/smoke-trigger \
  -d '{"suite":"nightly","simulate":true}'
```
Response should be 202 and PagerDuty ping within 30s.

jon: Verified the curl command works from jumpbox, PD received simulated alert.

sara: Quick reminder: if you need to escalate to infra, tag @infra on PD incident and include the trace id from the logs. Also KMS console is accessible with `sso login` only, not direct creds.

mari: Thanks. Last item: leave a short handoff note in the runbook under "current shift" with any ongoing anomalies. I'm seeing occasional 5xx from a canary model in us-west-2 — observing but not critical.

alex: noted, I'll add the canary 5xx spike with timestamps and a link to the grafana panel.

mari: Perfect. If no blockers here, I'll mark the shift in PD and handoff at 18:00. Appreciate the quick checks everyone. :rocket:
